newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Vickers leaps on bonus news, profits.
newsitem.headline: Vickers leaps on bonus news, profits.

text.p: Shares in Singapore stockbroker Vickers Ballas Holdings Ltd shot up in early trade on Wednesday after it announced a 41 percent rise in profits and proposed a one for one bonus issue.
"We're seeing predominantly retail buying, I think. People are really attracted by bonus issues, so that's obviously having an effect," said a dealer with a local brokerage.

Vickers Ballas reported profits of Singapore $48.55 million for the year to December 31, 1996 and said in a statement accompanying the figures it would double its issued share capital to S$121.76 million from S$60.88 million.
By 0150 GMT, Vickers Ballas stock had gained more than 10 percent, up Singapore $0.24 to S$2.48 on volume of 853,000 shares.
